title: Rehearsal: One Hand Clapping by Wings | 1974
content:
Studio Two, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

A day of rehearsals for Wings’ One Hand Clapping project took place on 25 August 1974.

The sessions were shot on videotape, and the audio was recorded by Geoff Emerick at Abbey Road. This was chiefly a rehearsal day, although it was filmed and recorded.

Wings began by playing ‘Hi, Hi, Hi’, ‘Jet’, and ‘Let Me Roll It’ before taking a break. They then performed ‘Soily’, ‘Blue Moon Of Kentucky’, and ‘The Mess’.

Paul McCartney switched to the piano for versions of ‘Nineteen Hundred And Eighty Five’, ‘My Love’, and a medley of ‘Little Woman Love’ and ‘C Moon’, followed by ‘Maybe I’m Amazed’ and ‘Live And Let Die’.

Picking up his bass guitar, McCartney led the band through ‘Band On The Run’, followed by a reprise of ‘Maybe I’m Amazed’ and a version of ‘Wild Life’.
